column1: # Real catalog ids: a deterministic, leaf-closed sample of the active production catalog
# (export of 2026-09-24, 118,439 rows, 106 providers). Columns: model id, provider id, sourceType.
# Rule: every row whose normalized last path segment is one of the selected names (the
# counterexample families, names with several snapshots, vendor products sharing a name,
# repository names shared by several owners, date/latest/publisher
# positives, md5-ordered caps), plus whole names so every catalog provider id is present.
# Keys computed on this sample alone equal the full-catalog keys for every row.
